description: The plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for three different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8)” and has a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A brown line with star-shaped markers represents “On-policy RL”, starting at approximately 74.5 at a temperature of 0.1 and ending at approximately 77.5 at a temperature of 1.0, with a peak at approximately 79.5 at a temperature of 0.7. A red line with star-shaped markers represents “LUFFY”, starting at approximately 76.0 at a temperature of 0.1 and ending at approximately 78.0 at a temperature of 1.0, with a peak at approximately 80.0 at a temperature of 0.7. A blue line with triangle-shaped markers represents “SFT”, starting at approximately 73.0 at a temperature of 0.1 and ending at approximately 74.5 at a temperature of 1.0, with a peak at approximately 77.0 at a temperature of 0.6.
